## File: facebookresearch_spreadingvectors/train.py

Prompts

```
['run the spreading vectors training script with triplet loss on a dataset like deep1b', 'run pairwise nearest neighbor computation on L2-normalized vectors using PyTorch on GPU', 'run triplet loss optimization with uniformity regularization on embedding vectors over multiple epochs', 'review the triplet_optimize function that trains a network using triplet and entropy loss', 'review the pairwise_NNs_inner function that computes nearest neighbors via dot products on GPU']
```

